title: El del billete
desc: Four years of paying with his face and never once looking
setting: You have handed Marcos a hundred-córdoba note and asked him who the man on it is.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: ¿Que quién es? Maje. Es Rubén Darío.
steps.en: Who is it? Maje. It is Rubén Darío.

options.es: Perdoname la ignorancia. ¿Y qué hizo él?
options.en: Forgive my ignorance. And what did he do?
options.feedback: Own it and ask. Everybody in this country learned him at school and nobody expects to have to explain who he is.

options.en: Ah, yes, I had heard something.
options.feedback: You had not. He can tell, and pretending costs you the explanation.

options.es: ¿Y por qué no ponen un presidente?
options.en: And why do they not put a president on it?
options.feedback: Because they put the poet instead, and that choice is the thing you are supposed to notice.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Es el poeta, maje. No un poeta. El poeta.
steps.en: He is the poet, maje. Not a poet. The poet.

options.es: Ya entendí la diferencia. ¿Y qué escribió?
options.en: I understand the difference. And what did he write?
options.feedback: The article was the whole correction. He is not one poet among several, he is the reason this country thinks of itself as a country of poets.
You repeated it back without asking anything. He is waiting to be asked.

options.es: En mi país nadie conoce poetas.
options.en: In my country nobody knows any poets.
options.feedback: That is exactly the thing not to say to a Nicaraguan holding a banknote with a poet on it.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Vos preguntale a Lucía. Ella se sabe los versos de memoria.
steps.en: You ask Lucía. She knows the lines by heart.

options.es: ¿De memoria? ¿Se los enseñaron en la escuela?
options.en: By heart? Did they teach them at school?
options.feedback: They did, to everybody, and most people can still say four lines thirty years later. That is the part that is hard to believe from outside.

options.es: Le voy a preguntar en la noche.
options.feedback: Do. The surprise is not the poem, it is that she will not have to look it up.

options.es: Seguro se acuerda de una sola.
options.en: I bet she only remembers one.
options.feedback: She will recite you three and then be annoyed. This is not a small piece of the education here.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Cuatro años cargando su cara en la bolsa y ni sabías.
steps.en: Four years carrying his face in your pocket and you did not even know.

options.es: Cuatro años, sí. Ya me toca ponerle atención al billete.
options.en: Four years, yes. About time I paid attention to the note.
options.feedback: Take the ribbing. He is not really talking about money, he is telling you there is a whole layer of this place you have been walking past.

options.es: Es que nadie me lo había dicho.
options.feedback: Nobody tells you what everybody knows. That is what makes it worth noticing yourself.

options.en: It is just a banknote, maje.
options.feedback: It is the biggest note in ordinary use and it has a man who wrote poems on it. That is not nothing here.
